prompt_markdown: A tool says `input()` gives back a number when someone types `7`. Your colleague says it gives text.

options.text: Ask the tool to explain again, and keep the version that sounds more sure.
Run a line that shows the type, and read the `input()` entry in the docs.
Go with your colleague, who has used Python for longer.
Search for a forum answer and keep whichever has more votes.
